what_happened: After handoff the ego braked hard (7.9 → 3 m/s) for actor 1, which was only about 5 m ahead, then drifted left onto the lane line. By 7.1 s it was about 10 m behind where the recorded car was, though only 1.4 m off its path. Actor 33, coming up from behind in the left lane on its recorded path, ran into the ego's rear-left side, which was logged as a lateral collision.

After braking hard behind lead car 1 (7.9 to about 3 m/s), the ego fell about 12 m behind where the recorded car was. Its planned path then bent left toward the left lane, and its front-left corner clipped actor 33, which was passing in that lane, while the ego was about 1.1 m left of the recorded path. Lead car 1 was still about 11 m ahead, so this was a lateral drift into the next lane, not a rear-end of the lead.

After slowing behind lead car 1, the ego left its planned route and drifted left toward the lane line, even though the command was RIGHT. At 7.6 s, moving at about 4 m/s, its front-left corner hit vehicle 33, which was travelling beside it in the left lane.

On the highway, the ego braked hard behind actor 1, then its planned path started moving left into the next lane. Actor 33 was coming up alongside in that lane, and the ego's front-left corner hit it at 7.6s, with actor 1 still about 11 m ahead.

In slow highway traffic, the ego drifted about 2 m left of the recorded path and ended up straddling the line into the left lane, even though the route command was RIGHT. Actor 51 was moving up alongside in that left lane, and the ego's front-left clipped its rear as it pulled ahead (front collision at about 4 m/s).

In slow freeway traffic stuck behind car 12, the ego changed lanes to the left at about 4 m/s, even though the route said RIGHT and the human driver had kept right. It cut in next to car 56, which was coming up in the left lane, and the two sideswiped (lateral collision; 56 also touched the ego's rear).

The ego was in slow highway traffic about 5.5 m behind car 12. It veered left into the next lane, against the RIGHT command and about 1.9 m left of the recorded path, and made side contact with car 56, which was coming up alongside and behind it in that lane.

In slow freeway traffic, the policy's plan (orange) turned left out of the ego's lane toward actor 15, even though the route command was STRAIGHT and then RIGHT and the recorded path kept going straight or bent right. By 7.7s the ego was about 2 m off the recorded path, sitting across the left lane line, and side-swiped actor 56, which was already in that left lane.

In slow highway traffic with a RIGHT command, the ego drifted left, away from the recorded path and toward the lane boundary, ending about 1.9 m off the recording. It made side contact with vehicle 51, which was travelling alongside in the left lane.

In slow highway traffic, with a RIGHT command, the ego sped up from 2.8 to 3.7 m/s and cut diagonally into the right lane. It hit the front of actor 5, a slow dark car only a few metres ahead in that lane. The recorded human path stayed in the current lane.

In slow, dense highway traffic with a RIGHT command, the ego sped up from 2.3 to 3.9 m/s and drifted right toward the next lane, about 1.8 m off the recorded path. Its front clipped actor 5, a slower car ahead and to the right in that lane, and it never braked.

In slow highway traffic, the command was RIGHT and the route followed vehicle 5 to the right. Instead, the ego drifted left out of its lane and its front struck vehicle 51, which was passing on the left. The ego was speeding up from 2.3 to 3.7 m/s, ended 1.8 m off the recorded path, and hit 51 when 51 was about 4 m ahead.

In slow, dense highway traffic, the ego swerved left out of its recorded lane to get around actor 5, which was moving slowly ahead. It then sped up from 2 to 4 m/s and cut back right toward its route (command RIGHT), and its front hit actor 5's left-rear corner (gap 2.1 m, about 1.9 m off the recorded path).

In slow highway traffic behind vehicle 5, the policy left its lane and the recorded path and steered left, even though the route command was RIGHT. Its front corner hit actor 51, which was driving alongside in the left lane, at about 4 m/s.

On a straight highway, the ego braked hard for no clear reason (17 down to 9.6 m/s, with no lead vehicle within about 50 m) while its planned path bent left toward the adjacent lane. Its front-left corner hit vehicle 1, which was driving alongside it in the left lane and had pulled slightly ahead as the ego slowed. The run was also flagged as rear-ended, likely by traffic behind reacting to the unneeded braking.
